title: UP minister demands SC reservation for Nishad community, holds protest on highway

ai.summary: Uttar Pradesh Cabinet Minister Sanjay Nishad held a protest on the Gorakhpur-Sonauli National Highway demanding SC reservation for the Nishad fishing community, which disrupted traffic for nearly two hours before being called off after talks with BJP state president.

facts.claim: Uttar Pradesh Cabinet Minister and Nishad Party president Sanjay Nishad held a protest along the Gorakhpur-Sonauli National Highway
facts.quote: Maharajganj (UP), Nov 18 (PTI) Uttar Pradesh Cabinet Minister and Nishad Party president Sanjay Nishad held a protest along the Gorakhpur-Sonauli National Highway here on Wednesday, demanding reservation for the fishing community under the SC category.

facts.claim: The protest disrupted traffic on both sides of the highway for nearly two hours as party workers blocked the road
facts.quote: The protest, which began around 4.30 pm, disrupted traffic on both sides of the highway for nearly two hours as party workers blocked the road.

facts.claim: The minister said he would not call off the protest until the government accepted the Nishad community’s demand for Scheduled Caste (SC) reservation
facts.quote: The minister said he would not call off the protest until the government accepted the Nishad community’s demand for Scheduled Caste (SC) reservation.

facts.claim: Earlier, a conference and march were also organised at Abhinav Vidya Mandir Inter College in Uditpur village under the Pharenda tehsil to press for the constitutional rights of the fishing community
facts.quote: Earlier, a conference and march were also organised at Abhinav Vidya Mandir Inter College in Uditpur village under the Pharenda tehsil to press for the constitutional rights of the fishing community.

facts.claim: Nishad said the community had been fighting for its constitutional rights and reservation for a long time. He claimed that the fishing community was entitled to SC reservation and said the struggle for its rights would continue
facts.quote: Addressing the gathering, Nishad said the community had been fighting for its constitutional rights and reservation for a long time. He claimed that the fishing community was entitled to SC reservation and said the struggle for its rights would continue.

facts.claim: After the conference, Nishad and his supporters reached the national highway and staged a sit-in
facts.quote: After the conference, Nishad and his supporters reached the national highway and staged a sit-in.

facts.claim: Following a conversation with BJP state president Pankaj Chaudhary, Nishad decided to call off the protest along with his supporters
facts.quote: Following a conversation with BJP state president Pankaj Chaudhary, Nishad decided to call off the protest along with his supporters.

ai.background_note: The Nishad community, a fishing community in Uttar Pradesh, has been seeking SC reservation for decades, with the current protest being part of ongoing efforts to secure constitutional rights and social recognition.
